Maria K.: Morning — quick async standup.
What I did: rolling prewarm in us-west, validated instance types, bumped spot fallback policy.
Blockers: seeing 5-10% higher evictions in us-west2 spot pools interfering w/ steady-state capacity; need to shift some capacity to on-demand or preallocated reserved GPUs.
Today: coordinate with cloud-ops to move 8 prewarm pods to on-demand, run a quota check for eu-west1 and ap-south1.

Jon P.: Noted. Can you paste the eviction metrics? Also what's the current reserved vs spot split?

Maria K.: eviction p95: 8.1% last hour, reserved: 42%, spot: 58%.
Here's the command I used to get counts:
```
./infra/misc/gpu-counts --region=us-west2 --type=spot --since=1h
```

Samir B.: I'll take on the quota checks for eu-west1. FYI finance flagged a spend spike for prewarms yesterday :grimacing:

Nisha R.: Thx Samir — ping me the quota output. Also @Maria K. can we lower prewarm retention from 45m->20m in non-prod regions? That should trim costs.

Maria K.: yes, will run a canary config change on staging: `PREWARM_RETENTION=20m` then monitor token latency.

infra-bot: Scheduled job 'prewarm-canary-staging' started by Maria K. — run id: canary-2026-03-17-08

Jon P.: One more ask — Samir, can you open a quick PR to update the provisioning docs with the new fallback thresholds? Small change.

Samir B.: On it, will target EOD.

Maria K.: nothing else from me, thanks. :thumbsup:
